BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Chair of the Board of Health Verbal Report, the Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report, and the reports titled: 2024 Nutritious Food Basket and Food Security, Climate Change and Health Vulnerability Assessments, Risk Management at Ottawa Public Health, Attendance at the Association of Local Public Health Agencies’ (alPHa) Fall Symposium, Delegation of Authority - Contracts Awarded for the Period of January 1 to June 30, 2024, be received and considered;
AND BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the Rules of Procedure be suspended to receive and table the report titled “2025 Draft Operating Budget for the Ottawa Board of Health”.

sub_agendas_items.title: Chair of the Board of Health Verbal Report
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
In her verbal report, Chair Kitts provided a recap of the Algonquin College Speaker Series and the Rural Summit and provided remarks regarding the 2025 Draft Operating Budget. 
The Board then voted to receive the Chair's Verbal Report. Discussions on this item lasted approximately 5 minutes.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive this verbal report for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
As part of her verbal report, Dr. Etches offered deepest condolences to all those grieving the recent loss and passing of the Honourable Murray Sinclair, I.P.C. She recognized the power of his leadership and his role as a visionary in matters of Indigenous justice and reconciliation, highlighting the enduring legacy he leaves behind that will certainly inspire actions to promote Indigenous wellbeing for generations to come. She then provided updates on fall respiratory illnesses, HART Hub Application, Health & Housing and the Drug Toxicity Crisis. In closing, she introduced Dr. Emil Azuma Prikryl, our newly appointed Associate Medical Officer of Health.  
The Board then voted to receive the Medical Officer of Health's Verbal Report. Discussions on this item lasted approximately 12 minutes.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive this verbal report for information.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Mohammad Kibria, Manager, Business and Development Support Services, spoke to a PowerPoint presentation which served to provide Board Members with an overview of the 2025 Draft Operating Budget. 
Following the presentation, staff responded to questions from Board Members. 
At 6:58 p.m., during discussions on this item, the Board approved a motion to extend the time of the meeting beyond 7:00 p.m.
The discussion on this item lasted approximately 24 minutes. The Board then voted to carry the report recommendations.

motions.motion_text: BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Board of Health approve that the meeting time be extended past 7:00 p.m. pursuant to Subsection 8(1)(c) of the Procedural By-law.
​​That, at its meeting of November 4, 2024, the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit:

BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Chair of the Board of Health Verbal Report, the Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report, and the reports titled: 2024 Nutritious Food Basket and Food Security, Climate Change and Health Vulnerability Assessments, Risk Management at Ottawa Public Health, Attendance at the Association of Local Public Health Agencies’ (alPHa) Fall Symposium, and Delegation of Authority - Contracts Awarded for the Period of January 1 to June 30, 2024, be received and adopted;
AND BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the report titled “2025 Draft Operating Budget for the Ottawa Board of Health” be tabled, for consideration at the Board of Health meeting of 2 December, 2024.
